description: Validate gpt-image-2 as the image generation backend for Swarm Manager decision-question mockups. Confirm API access from the target environment, measure real per-image cost at the quality we'd ship with (mockup-grade), verify image-as-input with input_fidelity='high' produces style-consistent outputs, and test 3-5 real-world decision scenarios end-to-end (pure text-to-mockup only — screenshot grounding is handled in the grounding-propagation initiative). Compare against the openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 composite on OpenRouter so we can justify going OpenAI-direct on cost. Deliverable: conclusion.md with recommended vendor, cost model per decision, prompt-template sketch derived from the OpenAI cookbook UI-mockup guidance, and a go/no-go call for the downstream execute items.
name: openai-image-gen-validation
title: Validate OpenAI gpt-image-2 for UI mockup generation
